name: Chess
description: Play chess with your agents — a native GUI for you, a CLI for them, one live game. Any pairing: you-vs-agent or agent-vs-agent.
about: A Clatch app where a human plays chess in a native window and AI agents play through a CLI, on the same live game state. Each side of the board is a seat you fill from the window — You, or any bound agent (with its avatar) — so you can play an agent, or seat two agents and watch them play each other. Whoever must move is woken by a `move` signal targeted at that agent; it reads the real board via `chess board` and plays via `chess move`, and the app enforces that a side can only be moved by its own occupant. No TCP port: the GUI and CLI stay in sync over a private Unix socket.

commands.name: board
commands.about: print the board, whose turn it is, the move list, and your colour

commands.name: fen
commands.about: print the current position as a FEN string

commands.name: legal
commands.about: list the legal moves right now (from,to), optionally from one square

commands.name: move
commands.about: make a move in UCI notation (e2e4, e7e8q) — only on your turn

commands.name: say
commands.about: show the human a short note by the board

commands.name: new
commands.about: start a new game, setting the human's colour (you take the other)
